design.independentUnit: offer-board; mean of both draft assignments and both physical seats
design.natural: 540 balanced maps/doctrines, current locked V3 opponents, no roster outcome filtering
design.counter: 540 balanced maps/doctrines, legal pressure draft, at least 3 own shooters and Griffin or >=2 melee flyers in each draft assignment, selected before combat
design.confirmation: 756 fresh boards per population; reserved before development
design.smoke: reuses two development boards; excluded as extra inference
design.fitPolicy: two fixed candidates: locked free-spread and a new situational selector; no tuning in this study

gates.primary: overall paired score gain >=1 percentage point and family-adjusted positive 95% interval versus current; situational must also pass versus free
gates.counter: free requires nonnegative paired target mean; situational requires a positive family-adjusted interval against both controls in the prespecified fast-threat population
gates.timing: observed mean full-fight time and mean total own decision time <=1.10 of matched controls; separate warm serial timing before any promotion
gates.finalist: highest development mean among gate-passing arms; ties use declared arm order
gates.confirmation: same gates, no replacing a failed finalist; no production activation by runner

orchestrationRepairBeforeOutcomes.reason: The locked first runner registers its own worker listener when imported on a worker thread. Run unchanged policies in eight main-thread Bun processes to avoid duplicate worker-ready messages.
